pr_metadata.title: Feature/#392 - Sort mechanism for `get_primary_scenarios()` and `get_scenarios()` API

gold_comments.issue_summary:
```suggestion
        If no filtering criterion is provided, this method returns all existing scenarios.
        If is_sorted is set to true, the scenarios are sorted by sort_key. If an incorrect
        or no sort_key is provided, the scenarios are sorted by name.
```
gold_comments.evidence_requirement: The docstring for get_scenarios() must explicitly state that when is_sorted is true, scenarios are sorted by sort_key (defaulting to 'name' if invalid/missing), but currently it only says 'If is_sorted is set to true, but an incorrect or no sort_key is provided, then the scenarios are sorted by name' in the Returns section.
gold_comments.rationale: A human reviewer would want the docstring to clearly explain the sorting behavior upfront rather than burying it in the Returns section, especially since the function signature now includes is_sorted and sort_key parameters.
